drop_bos.note: Presented as avoiding the copy that prepends BOS ('callers add it themselves'); Encode(s, true) no longer starts with the BOS token.

no_soft_hyphen_map.note: Drops the U+0143 -> 0xAD case from Decode's byte-level switch as 'unreachable'; tokens that carry byte 0xAD (the second byte of many UTF-8 characters, e.g. U+00ED) now decode to 'C'. The round-trip tests use no text containing that byte.

no_grow.note: Removes the up-front Grow in the byte-to-rune conversion as 'over-allocation'; the builder then reallocates as it grows, which is not cheaper.
